notes.title: News about changes since the early version
notes.content:
Anyone who has played the early access version or demo will notice that game has changed a lot. In addition to simply adding chapters, many things have changed. We will briefly inform you of what changes have occurred.


1. Convenience features

- Pressing Shift during battle will make the battle speed faster.
- Speed ​​control system has been added. It consists of 3 levels, and you can select you want to make the battle speed more faster. It can be set in options.
- Quick preset change system has been added. You can change a preset by pressing the left number key. Additionally, you can check the currently set preset number at the bottom left.
- You can find detailed information about the game through the encyclopedia.


2. New features

- You can find a Paddler in the commercial district. It sells rare items such as CP and PP stones. Items will remain even if you do not purchase them.
- You can find a Blacksmith in the military district. You can upgrade your weapons using godstone and mystic powder. Weapons have special effects when full upgrade.
- You can find a Collector in the military district. Collecting all of specific artifacts will grant you a comp artifact from Collector.
- You can find a Maid in the resident district. A special item is provided upon each return, and if you visit with a specific artifact, it will be randomly replaced with next tier artifact.
- You can find a Gambler in the resident district. Investing gold with a Gambler gives you a chance to win a prize on your next visit.
- Skill reset object has been added. You can find them during expedition, and you can only reset your presets once per visit. Please note that once you start setting, the number of times will be used up.
- When the game over, you can return to previous save point and get candle stacks. You can find a Old man in the military district and purchase stats using candle.
- KO stat has been added. If KO value exceeds 100 during battle, KO skill is activated. It kills common enemies immediately and causes great damage to elite and boss monstes. KO stat are retained after battle, allowing to use strategically.
- Items for sale in some town stores have been modified.


3. Improved features

- The acquisition period for class skills has been changed. Depending on progress of main story, certain skills are automatically unlocked.
- PP cost of class skills has been unified by tier. Balance work was carried out accordingly.
- Improvements have been made to several graphics sources.

notes.title: Getting late for a better game
notes.content:
Originally, the regular version update was scheduled to be released at the end of September, but we decided to take more time to improve various inconvenient experiences discovered through internal QA. We are trying to present the best game possible, but we were unable to meet the promised deadline, so we apologize to those who were disappointed.

To share with you what we're currently spending our time on. Once the urgent work is completed, we'll also proceed with previously promised update notes in form of news.


1. Game Over and Ending
: TOD is a strategic RPG played with limited resources in the game. It is a so-called Magic Tower-like game. Therefore, once growth is blocked, very uncomfortable situations in which progress is impossible often occur. Various variables have been adopted to try to alleviate this, but they still haven't solved the fundamental problems that are impeding progress.
 Therefore, if you lose a battle, rather than simply getting a game over, you will return to the previous save point and receive a special item called 'Candle', and we have set up a system where you can exchange this for some stats. These are awarded each time you return due to losing a battle, but there is a limit of 10 points each game. You can't obtain candles from the 11th regression and more, but it's not game over and you can continue from the previous save point.

: We have also prepared two endings, good and true. The good ending can be seen by defeating the last boss of the 5th tower, and the true ending can be achieved by defeating the last boss of the 5th tower at once without returning.
 The good ending has a separate epilogue depending on the final class. The true ending is the same regardless of class.


2. High-speed system
: The battle in the Magic Tower-like game is simple. You hit, enemy hit. That's why TOD has prepared various effects and SE and many skills, but even if you watch it hundreds of times, you will get tired of it. To solve this problem, we have prepared a high-speed system. 
 You can change this at any time in Option and change two things: normal combat speed and shift-pressing acceleration speed.


3. Skill and Town shop Reorganization
: From now on, the time to obtain each class skill is set. There is no case where you have to lead the game at a disadvantage because skill you want does not appear. Additionally, the number of skills you gain from the beginning increases, allowing for strategic play from the start. Promotion skills are granted immediately, allowing you to experience a stronger character more quickly.

: Town shop will also improve its location and offerings to sell more relevant products.



4. Story and Encyclopedia
: Currently, improvements and redesign are being made to the lowest priority work, game story and encyclopedia work. The story will fix some of the awkward parts and change to more intuitive content focusing on player characters, and the encyclopedia is being improved so that even players who are new to the genre can understand it.


Besides these, many minor improvements are in progress. It won't take long, so please wait a little longer.

notes.title: TOD May Dev Notes
notes.content:
May patch note has arrived.

The development of TOD is already looking at June. A large part of content is being developed simultaneously, and we are working hard to make game as well as possible. In this note, we share a lot of information with you.


- Balance Patch -

1. Player Skill Balance Adjustment
: Extensive balance adjustments have been made to all classes and shared skills. Skills with low value were buffed and some skills that had high value were nerfed. Also, some skill description lines have been modified to make them more suitable.


2. XP Stat Balance Fix
: Currently, Player's XP skills and artifacts are powerful enough to destroy the balance. So, we nerfed them drastically. Internal testing has confirmed that nerfed things are still useful.

3. KO Skill Adjustment
: KO skills are designed so that each class has its own, but too many KO skills are not fun and useful. Therefore, all KO skils are unified based only on the starting class. In addition, as the game progressed, there is a problem that the power of KO skill did not change, so from now on, each class upgrade will improve the KO skill.

Example)
Witch Hunter : Hacking
[Effects]
ATK 300% pierce damage
SPD +3 on self

class lv1
SPD +6 on self

class lv2
ATK 400% pierce damage

class lv3
Foe 3T : BLEED power 100%


4. Gate Adjustment
: There was a lot of key consumption between the 2nd and 3rd towers. 2nd tower consumed too many iron keys, so some were replaced with stone gates to resolve the imbalance in the number of doors, and 3rd tower had too many gates, so some were deleted and replaced with lower tier gates. In particular, we paid attention to ensure that there were no areas where progress was blocked, and as a good example, we added a gold key so that you can buy 1 gold key from the shop you hear after clearing 2rd tower.


5. Monster Balance Adjustment
: We nerfed monsters that were particularly powerful compared to other monsters.

- (1st) Venom bat's AP recovery is reduced to 2. 3 times attack was too merciless.
- (1st) Cultist's ATK is reduced.
- (1st) Werewolf Ranger's ATK is decreased.
- (1st) King of the Death's HP is increased.
- (2nd) Dracula One's HP is increased and ATK is decreased.
- (3rd) The stats of most monsters are slightly reduced.

: Along with this, the powerful monster skills were also nerfed.
- (Black Knight, Death Knight) Death blow skill's pierce effect has been removed.
- (Genie, Djinn, etc) Whirlwind skill's erosion power was decreased.
- (Overlord) Shake Spear skill's always activates bug was solved.


6. Bug Fixs
: A few minor bugs have been fixed, including some typos, gambling not being available, and save & load.

---

- Improvement and Preview -

1. Monster Guide UI Improvement
: From now, when you press E to check mob information, you can click on the mob image to see detailed information. Detailed stats and skills are displayed to make it easier to see than before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42943277/563563239994507d0db305c5b1a4e50c2ac01ff3.png[/img]
*The class name is written in Korean as one of the minor bugs mentioned above.

2. Class Skill Learning System Change
: Adjusted the timing of obtaining class skills. Tier1 skills have 3 fixed skills from the start, and 3 fixed skills are gradually unlocked depending on the time of return. Completing 1st tower unlocks all Tier1 skills. In the case of former class skills, upon completing the class upgrade, all skills of that tier are immediately obtained. You can get EXP when you get a previously existing class skill book.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42943277/a9d2b85f1b958f99abb0ec5b19f97047257a1656.png[/img]


3. Square Location Improvement
: In the square of the residen district, it has a function of outputting three randomly prepared lines. The original conditions are maintained, but the number of dialogues is large, but it is not very helpful, so we reduced the number and reorganized it to focus more on story disclosure and game progress tips.


4. 4th Tower Conent Preview
: Currently, 4th tower contents are being produced at a fast pace. Monster images and skills are almost ready, and a large amount of content will be introduced at once when the originally planned work is completed. The progress content, which has been divided and updated based on the time of return, will be completed with only two updates in the 4th tower. However, it may take a little more time because we prioritize the stabilization of existing content and adjustment of not so good content rather than adding new content.


5. SE Adjustment Notice
: We are currently intensively reviewing the sounds in the game. Sounds that are out of sync with animations, or output too loud or too soft, will be tweaked until the next patch.


In addition to these, small corrections are being made in the details. We are trying to bring out the good feeling of TOD as much as possible in various UI parts, including town animation adjustments.

Minor bugs are still being discovered after entering version 0.4, so translation errors and bugs that are not difficult are being fixed as soon as they are found. If you find any bugs, please report them in the comments or in the workshop.

notes.title: TOD March Dev Notes
notes.content:
Hello March! But, half of it is already gone.
This month's developer note is very late. There were in-depth discussions related to the core of the game and the overall UI, and changes came out day by day, so I held off writing notes until they were properly organized.
Now that we have solution of ​​how the game is going to change, let's find out!

First of all, it's about the upcoming regular patch.

1. Addition of Inquisitor class
: Finally, a new class is coming. There may still have bugs, but we're pretty much done with it and will add it to regular builds as soon as after a few internal tests.

2. Addition of 3rd tower 3/4 section
: We tried to put all 3rd tower contents in at once, but we need check out inquisitor class and 2nd class upgrade system. Therefore, we only want to add content up to 3/4 of the way. For now. 
We don't want to give you a pile of bugs.

3. Addition of town background animation
: An animation effect is added to the illustration of places that can be seen in town. It's a short and tiny animation, but we hope that more interest and realism will be conveyed to the game.


- Developer note for March  -

1. Guide book (before encyclopedia)
: It was because of the guide book that the story of a huge patch came out. The development team organized and shared according to the elements in the game in their own way, but this is a bit messy for newbie players to understand right away, so we make more easily expression along with improvements. The guide book will gradually be patched in line with step by step, only a few will be added with each update.

2. Skill
: We're trying to set a clear concept of skill for the job. For example, Sniper's main concept is to deal nuke damage in a short period of time, but it has a long-term skill that increases CRC every turn. We are modifying the skill to fit concept and considering deleting or moving the existing skill if necessary.

3. Story
: I'm thinking a lot, but I'm being pushed by other tasks and I'm not able to work properly about story. But now, this story is about to be overhauled in a completely different way than before. The current story is a bit of a twist on the paradigm with normal and common story, but I came up with a new story method that is more interesting and nice to look at. Of course, that won't increase the priority of story task, but I'd like to show you a story that has changed for the better someday.

4. UI
: Some UI will be improved. It has not yet been decided which parts will be improved, but we are planning to make big changes in the tutorial, battle, and skill UI. More intuitive and user friendly.

5. Etc
: We are currently adjusting the number of doors and keys throughout the map. The quantity of keys are tight, so there will be adjustment of the key and door so that there is no case of being blocked in the section where you cannot secure more keys, especially at the beginning of the 1st tower.

: There is a function that increases the combat speed by pressing the left shift. We put it in to speed up the test. TOD's battle speed is fast, but it's boring to watch over and over again, so we'll add this to the tutorial and guide. It's a feature that has been around since the demo, so there may be people who find it by chance and use it.



These are the developer notes for March.
Since there were so many changes, we ask for your understanding that it took a long time to write and confirm notes, and that it was difficult to explain in detail.
Thank you to everyone who has been interested in and playing TOD!

notes.title: TOD February Dev Notes
notes.content:
Hello! February has arrived. But it's already been over ten days.
There was Lunar New Year's Day in January, so development was later than expected.
February's content showcased a lot of things, starting with pre-release. In this news, explain that simply and share more information.


1. New Stage
: Regular builds are updated. It will be adjusted during the weekend, and we are currently testing meticulously to see if there are any bug issues.
There were no bad reviews for balance, but the overall opinion is that the difficulty is higher than other stages. If there is a problem, we will fix it soon.


2. New Skill
: New skills seen in the pre-release are added. Second class upgrade hasn't been opened yet, you won't be able to see the class skills right away. Common skills can be found right away.

: KO skill is in! Previous regular build was balanced considering of KO skill. We think there must have been quite a difficulty from the 1st tower. With the KO system, it has been confirmed that not only difficult monsters to deal with but also boss battles have become easier, so please look forward to it.

: Also, various skills has been modified. Skills that were too weak were buffed, and skills that were underutilized or bugged had their effects changed. It's been done quite extensively, so make sure to read the effects before set skills.

: Monster skills have also been added along with the pre-release.


3. New Artifact
: Although not pre-released, a total of 18 artifacts will be added. A few are added for each tier, and a new Epic tier has been added.

: The effect of some artifacts has also been modified for the same reason as skill.


4. Balance adjustment
: Minor balance fixes on some monsters.


- New Development Schedule  -


1. Inquisitor class
: Inquisitor class is not far. It is scheduled to be added in beta during February and will be available in regular builds during March.


2. 3rd Tower Complete
: We are aiming to complete the 3rd tower contents in February. Progress was slow as there were new systems added as stage progressed until the 3rd tower. But now, it's almost complete. Stage expansion should be fast!


3. Preview of 4th tower Contents
: Some contents of the 4th tower are currently in works. Several parts, including monster images, are in progress, and we are reviewing the direction of pre-release of some contents to sharing.


4. Main Story Translation
: Currently, the translation of the main story is stuck on Google Translate. There is no person specializing in translation. If we focus on translating the main story, the speed at which other content comes out will be very slow. We decided this wasn't good for everyone, so translation of the main story will be delayed a bit longer. It's unwelcome news for users who play in English. However, we would appreciate it if you could wait a little longer for a more good game.


5. Notice regarding Bugs
: The most important part of TOD development is related to bugs. From the demo until recently, there was a bug where some of the data was reset when some of the users returned to the town from the tower, and we put a lot of effort into solving that part. In particular, the development team had a lot of difficulty in fixing the bug because it could not be reproduced no matter what they did. If you find a progress bug like this, please let us know through the workshop or email!


6. Encyclopedia Update
: Encyclopedia will be updated so that you can learn more about the game description. In addition, we plan to add skills and artifacts that can be seen in the Encyclopedia.



These are the developer notes for February.
Thank you to everyone who has been interested in and playing TOD!

notes.title: TOD IMPORTANT NOTICE #1
notes.content:
Our team has had so many discussions about the TOD service to this day, and it has come to decision.


1. Change in price
: TOD is a little expensive game. This amount was set by predicting the finished product stage, but it came a burden for users. So, we continued to discuss whether it was right to change the amount while launching had already started. And after long consideration, we decided to lower the price. We will decrease TOD's price and not raise it again in the future so that more people can enjoy our games with a low price and users can be considered more reasonable. Some people have already purchased TOD at a high price. In order not to forget their support, we want to express our gratitude by in game contents.

 During this winter sale, TOD will be offering strong discounts and adjusting the prices of existing games once the event is over. Don't miss your chance to buy TOD during this winter sale! More cheap than after winter sale price.


2. Change of news serialization period
: There were few bad things to deliver to news every week. Our team doesn't have a lot of work to do to deliver something in the news every week. This kind of content can cause confusion to you, so we are going to change the serialization period from weeks to months. We think it is possible to save the good value of news by trimming and delivering relatively accurate information every month.


3. Delete of Demo version
: At the time of TOD's first release, we thought the length of the content was short, and since it's a minor genre. We included a demo version so that people who didn't like it bought it and didn't get disappointed. But now, due to the development of the 3rd tower, the content has been established to extent, the price of the game has been lowered, and many interested people already played demo. Therefore, we want to close the demo version before the winter sale. We would like to thank everyone who has played the demo. If you liked the demo version, you will also like the paid version.

notes.title: TOD Weekly News #6
notes.content:
Let's start sixth TOD weekly news.
This week news will focus on upcoming KO system remade.

<Before>
Anyone who have played Crusader character will have seen KO skill where enemies are sometimes killed in one hit.
The KO skill is a so-called victory skill that ends the game by inflicting damage that defeat the target monster in one shot.
However, the conditions that caused this were quite difficult.
- The target is not a boss type or a monster that is immuned from KO
- Your DEF will be higher than your opponent's ATK
- Occurs at a certain probability (default 7%) when attacked

Need to DEF had to be high, very difficult to see the KO itself for characters who grow mainly with ATK, such as witch hunter. Therefore, we want to sublimate this KO into a good game system by combining it with other feedback.

<After>
First of all, there is a new KO gauge. Start at 0/100 and collect all the gauges, will manually press the R key during combat to activate KO. It's difficult to activate right away in the combat sequence. So, it will be called in the closest processing sequence, turning it into a system that can directly intervene in the game. Similar to a smoke grenade.

Through this, I hope that many people gave me feedback about wanting to have something to intervene in battle. Auto-battle is good point for TOD, but we know some players need more control like us smoke bomb.
KO can be activated at any time to knock down the enemy in one shot. Still immune to bosses and some monster can be resist. But we considering the use of the changed KO, we are planning to use it strategically in boss fights as a ultimate skill that inflicts great damage. As long as it doesn't affect the balance too much.

The concept of the resources that fill the KO gauge is also finished to some extent. +1 per turn, +3 for defeating an enemy, +1 for completely blocking an enemy's attack (0 damage), etc. We designed the resources so that both offensive and defensive heroes can utilize KO.
In addition, by adding skills or artifacts that have effects such as adjusting the amount of resources obtained and the maximum value of the gauge itself. We are expanding many contents so that you can configure a skill tree that can actively use KO.

Lastly, KO skill have dedicated effects. It is not currently implemented, but each character class has a different KO effect. This will be applied at the same time as change. It is longer and more wonderful than other effects.



Currently, the KO system are still under discussion. It may change as posted in the news today, or it may change in a slightly different direction. If you have any opinions about the KO system, please comment.

3rd tower beta testing is ongoing. Some bugs and balance patches are also made from time to time. That are not announced separately. If you run into any issues during beta playing, please let us know through the community or comments.

Thanks for watching weekly news!

notes.title: TOD Weekly News #1
notes.content:
First TOD weekly news has started.

We want to keep you informed on a weekly basis until the game is officially release.
In the news, we plan to provide the latest information on various game developments and issues of users.
However, please note that the information disclosed here is only a plan and is not always apply.


< Early Access Version Release Review >
There were many things before released. It's mainly a COVID-19 problem, so we can't control that. Nevertheless, we did not give up. After a long journey, somehow managed to release an early access version. Thanks again to everyone who helped build and test the game and you!

The price of the package is high compared to other games. Actually, I wanted to write an ambiguous explanation for in the Early Access Introduction. But due to Steam policy, we couldn't make a specific promise to you, so we tell you this through news and updates.
Obviously, we are aiming to complete a game that is worthy of our price. We are also considering means such as adding multiple content and releasing a map editor for a game that is fun to play many times rather than just one-time consumption content.


< 3rd Tower Development >
Currently, 3rd tower is under development.

The 3rd tower are located in the southern desert area in the world. It called the Tower of abyss.
Among the evil companions, this is where the Beast are mainly garrisoned. For example, can see familiar mobs such as goblin and orc, as well as desert-related mobs such as sandstone golem and sphinxes.

The progression of the three towers is special. First of all, you can go up to the ground only after you have run all the way underground. The floors of the ground and underground also same.
A proper secret room appears from the 3rd tower and some of them have a hidden boss. In terms of game balance, it's designed to be cleared without visiting the secret room, so visiting the secret room will lower difficulty of the game and give a chance to make up for mistakes.

In addition to this, several contents are under development. In the near future, we will be able to introduce you to not only texts but also samples.


< Equipment Upgrade >
You can get many equipments within TOD. So far, acquiring equipment has only been an item that raises the stat a little more than others, but other growth ways are opened from the 3rd tower.

Equipment upgrade is to select the desired equipment and upgrade its ability. Equipment upgrade is carried out with the ‘Godstone’ item, and those who have visited to the 2nd Tower will have experience in obtaining that item. The Godstone becomes a resource that enables equipment upgrade along with ‘Mystic powder’ to be added later.

All available equipment can be upgraded. Upgrade can be up to 3 levels in total, and ability and material consumption increases according to level. Each equipment has its own abilities obtained and we plan to balancing low-tier equipments so that there is no unconditional disadvantage to upgrade.


< New class >
A new class Inquisitor is in development. More details about the Inquisitor will be released later, and for now, we will only simple comparative information.

- It has stronger stats compared to witch hunter and crusader.
- Attack and defense are balanced, but the synergy between skills is inferior compared to other classes.
- Proficient in control bad conditions, especially with Purify and Dispel techniques.
- Purpose is to make the easiest class for beginners to play.
